enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Arms resting at sides. Legs straight. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket up to shoulders. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Turning to right side. Kicking off blanket. Pulling blanket back over legs. Shifting position. Lying on back. Eyes closed. Breathing deeply. Remaining still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower (finishing before Member 1 uses the bathroom at 07:10)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Pour shampoo into hand. Apply to hair. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and reading news and checking emails on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out underwear. Put on underwear. Pick out shirt. Put on shirt. Pick out pants. Put on pants. Pick out socks. Put on socks. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through headlines. Tap on article. Read article. Open email app. Check inbox. Open email. Read email. Reply to email. Put down phone. Adjust shirt collar.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and preparing and eating breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take out milk. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out butter. Take out plate. Wait for toast. Butter toast. Pour boiling water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir tea. Add milk. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Say good morning to Member 1. Talk about day plans. Finish eating. Rinse plate. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading news and checking emails on phone while planning the day
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through headlines. Tap on article. Read article. Open email app. Check inbox. Open email. Read email. Open calendar app. Review schedule. Add event. Set reminder. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the desk and setting up the computer, monitor and desk lamp for remote work
enriched_activities.desc: Clear desk. Wipe desk with cloth. Pick up computer. Place computer on desk. Open computer. Connect monitor cable. Place monitor on desk. Adjust monitor angle. Plug in desk lamp. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust lamp direction. Arrange keyboard and mouse.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on arts administration tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email program. Read emails. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Open document. Type report. Make phone call. Take notes. Stretch arms. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Return to desk. Sit down. Continue typing. Save file. Close document. Open email. Send email. Check calendar. Make to-do list.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch on the induction cooker together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Place food on plates. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Talk with Member 1. Finish eating. Rinse plates. Place plates in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work on the monitor and computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open illustration software. Create new canvas. Pick up stylus. Sketch outline. Draw lines. Fill colors. Adjust layers. Save file. Export image. Take break. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to desk. Sit down. Continue drawing. Add details. Save file. Close software.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea and having an afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Take out mug. Take out biscuits. Place biscuits on plate. Wait for kettle. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat biscuit. Drink tea. Check phone. Finish. Rinse mug. Place mug in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner on the induction cooker together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Wash ingredients. Chop ingredients. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add sauce. Cover pan. Turn off cooker. Serve on plates. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1. Finish eating. Rinse plates. Place plates in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing quietly while Member 1 washes the dishes and wipes the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Scroll through news. Put down phone. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Look at pictures. Put down magazine. Stand up. Walk to window. Look outside. Turn around. Walk back to sofa. Sit down. Close eyes. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Change channel. Sit on sofa. Watch program. Talk to Member 1. Laugh. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sketching personal illustration ideas with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up sketchbook. Pick up pencil. Open sketchbook. Start drawing. Erase line. Sharpen pencil. Continue drawing. Turn page. Draw new sketch. Put down pencil. Stretch hands. Pick up pencil. Add details. Close sketchbook. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed (before Member 1 uses the bathroom at 22:00)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Floss teeth. Wash hands. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Adjust pillow. Shift position. Continue reading. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Lie on back. Eyes closed. Breathing deeply. Remain still.
